title: We will repeat
text:
We celebrated a great party, my husband's birthday, and a crazy desire to live.
3 hours at sea, with entertainment, music, and food, all very good and, above all, fun and different. Do not miss this experience; it is worth innovating, and the price is very good for everything they offer. We were almost 90 people, but there are smaller catamarans, and also other prices depending on the package you choose. Take advantage of the good weather and enjoy to the fullest.
Thanks to the entire crew; they could not have treated us better.
We will repeat

title: Unforgettable experience
text: Dani, the captain is an excellent person and a great professional, he made our experience unforgettable. Thank you so much!
author: Adventure608528

title: A great day with family and friends
text:
We loved the sailing time and especially the entrance and exit of the Port Olimpic de Barcelona. We founded in front of a beach of Maresme where we could enjoy a pleasant family swim and even with paddle surfing our son came to the sand and came back. 
The boat very nice and impeccable, and a great appetizer, which we enjoyed throughout the trip..
Dani, the boss, a great professional who, if you ask him, does not lack an anecdote or some adventure to tell.... 
Definitely a great day and an unforgettable experience.
Highly recommended....
author: U3369MXdiegov

title: Wonderful day by the sea
text: It was a wonderful day on the sea from Barcelona, the boat was excellent, the captain was very friendly and competent. We love to sit in front of the boat and enjoy the sun. We stopped at a place where the water was very blue and pleasant. Our son rode stand up paddle board for the first time.
author: Y4413FSvanessac

title: Bcn from a beautiful and different perspective. Don't miss it!
text: What a great morning! We discovered Barcelona from the sea, and while we were seeing all the most iconic buildings from this totally different perspective, we enjoyed some drinks and snacks. A wonderful experience!!! We highly recommend it!
